description: This file defines a React component for displaying toast notifications with customizable styles, icons, actions, and animations. It manages the toast's appearance, dismissal animations, and user interactions.

methods.name: prefersReducedMotion
methods.description: Detects if the user has requested reduced motion preferences.

methods.name: colorForToastType
methods.description: Returns CSS classes for background and text color based on the toast type.

methods.name: iconForToastType
methods.description: Returns appropriate icon JSX element based on the toast type.
